description: Enhanced with Rayner Teo breakout rules — buildup detection, retest entries, 20 EMA proximity, ATR stops

entry_rules.1_buildup: Tight consolidation (buildup) at resistance = sign of strength. 20-25 candles in tight range near a level → breakout likely.
entry_rules.2_higher_lows: Higher lows into resistance (ascending triangle) = buyers getting aggressive. Strong breakout signal.
entry_rules.3_retest: After breakout, wait for price to come back and retest broken level as support. Safer entry, better R:R.
entry_rules.4_ema_proximity: Best entries when price is CLOSE to 20 EMA (hugging it). Gives tight stop + swift move. Don't enter when far from 20 EMA.
entry_rules.5_strong_trend: In strong trend (price below/above 20 EMA consistently), trade breakdowns/breakouts of swing lows/highs near the 20 EMA.

stop_loss: 1 ATR below the swing low of the buildup/pattern. NOT just below last candle — below the PATTERN low.
take_profit: Entry + (2 x stop_distance) minimum. If strong trend, trail with 20 EMA.

key_differences_from_v80.1: Buildup detection — look for tight consolidation before breakout, not just EMA position
key_differences_from_v80.2: Retest entries — if we miss the initial breakout, wait for the retest instead of chasing
key_differences_from_v80.3: 20 EMA proximity — only enter when price is near EMA 21 (our closest to Rayner's 20 MA). Skip if extended far above/below
key_differences_from_v80.4: ATR-based stop below pattern low — not just last candle low. More room but still sized to $10 risk
key_differences_from_v80.5: Ascending/descending triangle detection — higher lows into resistance or lower highs into support

chart_checklist.1: Is there a BUILDUP (tight consolidation) at a key level?
chart_checklist.2: Is price within 1 ATR of EMA 21? (proximity check)
chart_checklist.3: Are there higher lows into resistance? (ascending triangle)
chart_checklist.4: Is this a RETEST of a broken level? (second chance entry)
chart_checklist.5: What is the ATR(14)? Stop = 1 ATR below pattern swing low
